As your Ogeemo Assistant, I can help you create a new contact right within the Contacts Hub.

To do this, you'll first open the Contacts Hub from the main navigation. Then, you'll locate the "create contact" entry point and enter all the necessary information, such as the contact's name and phone number. After reviewing to make sure everything looks correct, you can save the workflow and wait for confirmation. Remember to record any relevant details for future reference or audit.
